headline: Public hearing on zoning variance requests for 2188 Candia Road, 2266 Candia Road, 235 Carnegie Street, 44 Cricket Lane, and other properties.
summary: The agenda lists ten public hearing cases on zoning variance requests for homes, lots, and businesses in Manchester. It also includes a rehearing request for a 34-lot subdivision on Wellington Road.
items: ZBA2026-058, 2188 Candia Road: outdoor vehicle storage for the auto repair use at 2266 Candia Road, six parking spaces at the lot line, and 64.9% lot coverage; variances requested.
ZBA2026-064, 2266 Candia Road: expand auto repair use area by adding 13 parking spaces, lot coverage from 55% to 75%, and no required perimeter landscaping; variances requested.
ZBA2026-063, 26 Titus Avenue: two townhouse buildings with 13 units total; postponed to September 10, 2026.
ZBA2026-065, 235 Carnegie Street: second-floor addition with reduced front and side yard setbacks; variances requested.
ZBA2026-067, 44 Cricket Lane: 8-foot fence in the street yard of a through lot; variance requested.
ZBA2025-068, 308 Lake Avenue: convert commercial space to four new dwelling units for a six-unit small multi-family; driveway width and parking setback variances requested.
ZBA2026-069, 106 Longwood Avenue: 30 by 30 foot addition for a third dwelling unit; lot width, buildable lot area, transparency, and driveway width variances requested.
ZBA2026-070, 15 Windswept Road: 6-foot fence in the street yard of a corner lot, within the 25-foot wetlands setback; variances requested.
ZBA2026-071, 102 Talbot Street and Crawford Street, TM 609, Lot 46: subdivide and consolidate three lots into four lots; variances and relief from RSA 674:41 requested.
ZBA2026-073, 146 Maynard Street: 20 by 18 foot carport in the side yard with a 5-foot side setback; variance requested.
Rehearing request for ZBA2026-060, Wellington Road, Tax Map 860, Lot 30: rehearing of a variance for a 34-lot subdivision granted July 9, 2026, including lot width for six cul-de-sac lots.
location: City Hall, Third Floor, Aldermanic Chambers, One City Hall Plaza, Manchester, New Hampshire 03101

II. Public Hearing 
A. Current Cases 
1) ZBA2026-058, 2188 Candia Road 
BC-2 Zoning District, Ward 6 
Eli Leino, Esq. (Agent) proposes to create an accessory outdoor vehicle storage use to 
be used by the auto repair use located next door at 2266 Candia Rd. in the Lake 
Massabesic Protection Overlay District, create six new parking spaces 0’ from the lot

Minimum Setback of One Side of the Zoning Ordinance of the City of Manchester, New 
Hampshire as per documents submitted through June 24, 2026.

R-1A Zoning District, Ward 1

III. Business Meeting 
A. Requests for Rehearing 
1) ZBA2026-060, Wellington Road, Tax Map 860, Lot 30 
R-1A and LMPOD Zoning District, Ward 2
